svg.title: PUGZ architecture
svg.desc: How PUGZ fits together. Players and staff reach the website through Cloudflare and Nginx on the main droplet, and Discord talks to the bot over its gateway. The website sends commands to the bot and gets responses back. The website, the bot and the worker all use one PostgreSQL database with change notifications; the worker, on its own droplet, processes the job queue and syncs with Embark, Steam, Twitch, Stripe, Resend and Liquipedia. A nightly encrypted backup goes off-site.
